Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 18
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament
Monday, Jestha 25, 2083
11:00 AM
Nomination to the Business Advisory Committee
1. The Honorable Speaker will inform about the nomination of Honorable Members to the Business Advisory Committee.
2. Commencement of discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure
The Honorable Minister of Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, will present the proposal to "Commence general discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for the Fiscal Year 2083/084".
3. General discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for the Fiscal Year 2083/084 will commence.
4. The Honorable Minister of Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, will respond to the questions raised during the discussion.
Management Work
The Honorable Minister of Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle:-
(a) Will present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Appropriation Bill, 2083".
(b) Will introduce the "Appropriation Bill, 2083".
(c) Will present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Public Debt Raising Bill, 2083".
(d) Will introduce the "Public Debt Raising Bill, 2083".
(e) Will present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(f) Will introduce the "Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The Honorable Speaker will announce the nomination of members to the Business Advisory Committee. This marks the beginning of the parliamentary proceedings.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Minister of Finance will initiate a general discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for FY 2083/084. Following the discussion, the Minister will respond to questions raised by members.

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: The Minister of Finance will seek permission to introduce and subsequently present three key bills: the Appropriation Bill, 2083, the Public Debt Raising Bill, 2083, and the Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083.
